meta.siteTitle: The Sylvana Restaurant | Authentic Bengali Cuisine in Shahbagh, Dhaka
meta.siteTagline: দ্যা সিলভানা রেস্টুরেন্ট - Traditional Flavours & Warm Hospitality
meta.metaDescription: Experience authentic Bengali cuisine, Kacchi Biryani, hearty breakfast, and Continental dining at The Sylvana Restaurant in Shahbagh, Dhaka.

hero.badge: ✨ Authentic Bengali & Continental Dining in Shahbagh, Dhaka
hero.subtitle: Discover the vibrant taste of Dhaka with our authentic Mutton Kacchi Biryani, hearty morning breakfast, fresh clay-oven naans, and gourmet dishes crafted fresh every day at Shahbagh, Dhaka.

items.name: Paratha with Bhaji
items.description: Crispy, flaky tawa paratha served hot with spiced seasonal vegetable bhaji.

items.name: Paratha with Dim Bhuna
items.description: Hot layered paratha served with eggs simmered in a rich onion and tomato bhuna gravy.

items.name: Bhuna Khichuri with Omelette
items.description: Fragrant Chinigura rice and yellow lentil khichuri served with green chili onion omelette.

items.name: Shahi Suji Halwa with Paratha
items.description: Sweet aromatic semolina halwa cooked in pure ghee, raisins and cardamom with warm parathas.

items.name: Clay Oven Naan with Dal Butter
items.description: Soft, freshly baked tandoori naan served with warm spiced lentil curry and melting butter.

items.name: Special Masala Milk Tea
items.description: Authentic Bengali slow-boiled creamy milk tea infused with cardamom, clove, and fresh ginger.

items.name: Special Mutton Kacchi Biryani
items.description: Slow-cooked tender mutton marinated in curd and secret spices, layered with fragrant basmati and alu.

items.name: Old Dhaka Beef Tehari
items.description: Classic mustard oil aroma, short-grain Chinigura rice and succulent beef cubes cooked to perfection.

items.name: Shahi Chicken Roast with Polao
items.nameBn: শাহী চিকেন রোস্ট ও মোরগ পোলাও
items.description: Rich caramelized onion and cashew gravy over crispy chicken leg, paired with aromatic ghee polao.

items.name: Mezbanee Beef Bhuna with Rice
items.nameBn: মেজবানি বিফ ভুনা ও সাদা ভাত
items.description: Authentic Chittagong Mezban spiced tender beef curry served with steaming fragrant rice.

items.name: Rui Fish Curry with Alu Bhorta & Dal
items.nameBn: রুই মাছের ঝোল, আলু ভর্তা ও ডাল
items.description: Freshly caught sweetwater Rui fish in light cumin gravy, traditional mustard potato mash and yellow dal.

items.name: Sylvana Special Chowmein & Crispy Chicken
items.nameBn: স্পেশাল চাউমিন ও ক্রিস্পি ফ্রাইড চিকেন
items.description: Wok-fried egg noodles with vegetables and spicy golden fried chicken pieces.

items.name: Gourmet Beef Cheese Burger with Fries
items.nameBn: বিফ চিজ বার্গার ও ফ্রেঞ্চ ফ্রাই
items.description: Flame-grilled beef patty, melted cheddar cheese, fresh lettuce, tomato, special sauce, and crisp fries.

items.name: Garlic Butter Naan with Chicken Butter Masala
items.description: Crisp garlic-coriander naan brushed with butter, paired with creamy boneless chicken butter masala.
